name: Home Screen Sections
description: Fork of IAmParadox27/jellyfin-plugin-home-sections built and tested for Jellyfin 10.11.11. Adds a modular home screen with configurable sections. Requires the File Transformation and Plugin Pages plugins.
overview: Modular home screen sections for Jellyfin 10.11.11 (fork).

versions.changelog: Seerr now opens as a popup on top of the current Jellyfin page (Discover cards and the Seerr menu entry) instead of a full page or a new tab. Close with the X, Esc or by clicking outside.

Seerr cards in Discover now open Seerr inside Jellyfin (deep-linked to the movie/series) instead of a new tab. Patched web chunks are cache-busted with the plugin version so updates reach browsers and CDNs immediately.
Adds a Seerr page that embeds your Jellyseerr/Seerr inside Jellyfin (entry in the main menu and under Plugin Settings). Uses the external Seerr URL from the plugin settings.
Jellyfin 10.11.11 build. Fixes the Modular Home menu link (404 caused by jellyfin-web stripping .html), cache-busts the patched main bundle, adds Spanish translations. See FORK_NOTES.md.
